other_conditions: Must possess a Ph.D/MD degree or equivalent in life sciences, agriculture, bioinformatics, or a related field, or an M.Tech in engineering, technology, or medicine.
Must have at least three years of post‑doctoral research experience in overseas research laboratories.

Candidates who have returned to India within one year of the advertisement (two years for women candidates) are eligible, provided they have not secured a permanent position in India during that period.
Applicants must have a proven/outstanding research track record evidenced by publications and recognitions.
If the fellow joins a permanent position, the fellowship and HRA components are discontinued, though the research‑grant component may continue for the remaining tenure.
Before the fellowship starts, the fellow must submit a two‑member advisory committee comprising one member from the host institute and one from another institute in India or abroad.
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹1,00,000 with HRA of ₹18,500, an annual research support grant of ₹13,00,000 and ₹50,000 institutional overhead.
